messages:
maria: heads up — macOS CI started failing after the toolchain roll this morning, looks like a symlink change broke clang paths. seeing lots of 'file not found' from compile.
ci-bot: buildkite/infra-macos #1245 failed: //lib:core_tests (exit code 1)
lee: ugh, thanks for the ping. can you paste the failing command/log snippet?
maria: sure — here's the top error from the macos worker:
```
/Users/build/.cache/bazel/_bazel_root/xxxx/execroot/redwood/bazel-out/darwin-fastbuild/bin/external/llvm_toolchain/bin/clang++: error: no such file or directory: '/usr/local/opt/llvm@14/bin/clang'
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
```
aj: so the symlink expected llvm@14 but the new image installed llvm@15 and changed the symlink to `llvm` -> llvm@15. any easy workaround is to update toolchain config to point to `llvm` instead of `llvm@14`, but need to be cautious for reproducibility.
sahil: who pushed the toolchain roll? @lee or infra team?
lee: that was from infra PR #892 — we upgraded images to include llvm@15. didn't realize some build configs still reference `llvm@14` explicitly.
maria: quick triage results: locally `bazel build //lib:core_tests` on macos image with llvm@15 fails, swapping the symlink back to llvm@14 on the worker fixes the build.
aj: can we hotfix the image or add a fallback in the CMake toolchain file? short term revert the roll, medium term make toolchain lookup prefer `llvm` then `llvm@*`.
maria: reopening CI rerun now after a symlink revert attempted on one host.
buildkite: rebuild triggered by maria — job 1246 queued
ci-bot: job 1246 started on macos-x86-01
ci-bot: job 1246 failed again: same missing '/usr/local/opt/llvm@14/bin/clang'
sahil: odd — maybe the agents have mixed images. can someone bisect which rolling image introduced the path? we need the list of hosts and their image tags.
lee: checking infra hosts, it looks like rolling update completed in two waves. full rollout merged at 1780029000 (PR #892). some hosts still on old image until they restarted.
aj: maria, can you run `which clang` and `ls -l /usr/local/opt` on the failing worker and paste output?
maria: pasted from the worker:
```
$ which clang
/usr/local/opt/llvm/bin/clang
$ ls -l /usr/local/opt
lrwxr-xr-x  1 root  admin  20 Mar 27 09:12 llvm -> ../Cellar/llvm@15/15.0.1
lrwxr-xr-x  1 root  admin  22 Mar 27 08:55 llvm@14 -> ../Cellar/llvm@14/14.0.6
```
maria: so `llvm` points to 15 but some configs still hardcode `llvm@14` path; bazel's toolchain discovery expects `llvm@14` for that target.
sahil: ok let's do this: (1) stop the rolling update immediately (lee), (2) add a fallback in our `cmakedefs/toolchain.cmake` to prefer `llvm` if `llvm@14` not found (aj + maria), (3) open a follow-up infra PR to standardize symlink names and image tags (lee).
lee: on it — pausing the roll and posting in infra channel. creating a revert PR for the macos image now.
aj: I'll prep a tiny patch for the toolchain lookup with small tests. will also include a Bazel host toolchain fallback using `--action_env=CLANG_BIN` override as temporary workaround.
maria: pinging @eng-infra — can someone do a quick CI rerun for job 1246 once revert lands? if flaky we might need bisect across commits.
buildkite: job 1247 queued (manual trigger by lee)
ci-bot: job 1247 succeeded on macos-x86-02 :thumbsup:
sahil: nice. can we add a short postmortem note in incidents/ or post a summary in #eng-infra when we have concrete fixes? want to capture that hardcoded `llvm@14` assumption.
maria: will write a short note after aj/lee finish patches. thanks everyone for the quick responses. :raised_hands:
lee: follow-up PRs: infra revert #895, toolchain fallback #896. tagging for review.
aj: assigned to me, will land tests + patch today.
sahil: assigning a small follow-up to devex to update our onboarding doc about toolchain pinning.
maria: closing the thread for now — reopen if CI flaps again.
